APPROVE

The extracted `AppendStar` reproduces the original `*`, `**/` and trailing `**` branches with identical output and the same returned index, so `ToRegex` loses about 7 points of cognitive complexity (the nested ifs and elses) and drops below 15. The new code uses only constructs the file already uses, so it should build without new warnings, though I haven't run the build.
